The Brodit saga starts in June 1983. Taxi driver Ebbe Johansson had bought his first mobile phone, he sat in his car and tried to find out where he should place the handset. At that time, mobile phones were not as practical as today. They are more similar to suitcases weighing about 20 kg (40 lbs) and a receiver that was as large as a brick, so it was not so easy to find a good place in the car. After the shift Ebbe went home into his garage and bent a piece of plastic that he attached to the dashboard. Perfect! The receiver has been placed within reach without blocking anything, firmly in place without damaging the interior. The first ProClip was born.
